races.paceDynamic: Chamonix will take the field along as the sole confirmed front-runner, setting an uncontested lead with no early pressure expected. The three prominent runners (Alphonsus Liguori, Dark Leader, Oro Blanco) will track behind in the second rank, while the large hold-up contingent settles at the rear. With Chamonix able to dictate fractions unchallenged, this creates a tactical race where positioning and timing become crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and strike when Chamonix weakens, as they avoid both the front-runner's workload and the hold-up horses' traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Chamonix sets steady fractions and the prominent trio get good racing room turning for home
scenarios.body: The three tracking horses can time their challenges perfectly as Chamonix tires, with their superior ratings telling late. Hold-up horses face too much ground to make up against this calibre.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Chamonix Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the modest overall pace allows Chamonix to conserve energy and the prominent runners fail to sustain their challenges
scenarios.body: Despite his lower rating, Chamonix gets first run on his rivals and proves tough to peg back when getting soft sectionals. His front-running style maximizes his limited ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very sedate and the prominent runners don't quicken decisively enough turning in
scenarios.body: Mergus Serrator times his run perfectly through a gap as the others falter, with his superior turn of foot decisive. The slow pace negates the hold-up horses' usual positioning disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Upset
scenarios.trigger: If Henry Hudson or Vico Road possess significant undisclosed ability and benefit from their fresh conditions
scenarios.body: One of the newcomers shows a level of ability that their connections have been hiding in work. Their lack of racing pressure and unknown potential creates the upset factor.

races.paceDynamic: What About Us shapes as the sole natural front runner in this small field, giving her an uncontested lead over the first half mile. With prominent runners Glyfada and Flawless Fusion likely settling just behind, the early pace will be measured rather than fierce. The lack of pace pressure should allow What About Us to dictate terms and kick for home at her own choosing, while the hold-up trio of Mo Mhuirin, Mighty Danu and Sursum Corda will need the leaders to come back to them in the straight. This race setup clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can travel kindly in the early stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If What About Us gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows her to save energy for a decisive move, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on good ground that won't slow the leaders significantly. Her class edge at OR 88 tells when she gets ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Glyfada or Flawless Fusion can slip the leader's kick and out-finish
scenarios.body: The measured early pace brings stamina into play where both have shown quality, with Glyfada's recent winning form and Flawless Fusion's higher RPR of 95 providing the class to capitalize. They get first run on the weakening leader while closers are too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint from the furlong pole
scenarios.body: Mo Mhuirin or Sursum Corda get the perfect setup where their closing kick can overwhelm tired leaders in the final 100 yards. The soft ground aids their finishing effort while punishing those who led throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If interference or a muddling pace creates an unconventional race shape
scenarios.body: Mighty Danu's hold-up style could prosper if the race falls apart tactically, allowing her to pick up the pieces despite moderate recent form. Her previous course winner profile gives her an edge if others disappoint.

watchPoints.text: What About Us could steal this if she gets soft fractions early and the field allows her to build an unassailable lead.

Observe whether the hold-up horses can get any closer than usual in the early stages given the likely pedestrian pace.

races.paceDynamic: Jasmine Affanalis will attempt to lead this field of 18 from the outset, but with only one confirmed front runner she's unlikely to face early pressure. This sets up a moderate to steady pace through the opening stages, allowing the hold-up horses behind to settle comfortably. The large field creates natural bunching and tactical positioning battles, but without pace pressure the race will develop into a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a late kick, as they'll benefit from the moderate early gallop and have plenty of cover to deliver their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Steady Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Jasmine Affanalis leads unopposed and sets moderate fractions
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows patient hold-up horses to settle and deliver strong late runs. Horses with proven finishing kicks and tactical speed will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Jasmine Affanalis gets an easy lead and quickens approaching home
scenarios.body: The leader capitalizes on soft fractions to build an unassailable advantage turning for home. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground despite the moderate early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid Race Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Jasmine Affanalis for the lead through mid-race
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more honest as horses fight for position, creating gaps and opportunities for well-positioned runners. Those handy to the pace benefit from the increased tempo.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates interference and bunching in the straight
scenarios.body: The finish becomes a lottery with several horses having chances but traffic problems determining the outcome. Horses drawn wide or getting clear runs benefit most.

races.paceDynamic: Honouramongthieves will make the running uncontested, as he's the only confirmed front-runner in this field. With Delusional and Chicago Moon likely to track him in prominent positions, the pace should be moderate and manageable through the middle stages. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses who will need to be delivered late, creating potential traffic problems in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers, as they'll have clear runs while the hold-up brigade may struggle to find racing room when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire domination
scenarios.trigger: If Honouramongthieves gets an easy lead and controlled fractions
scenarios.body: The leader will kick clear turning for home before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges. With only modest pace pressure early, he can dictate terms and prove hard to peg back over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely run and Honouramongthieves weakens
scenarios.body: Delusional or Chicago Moon can strike from their tracking positions as the leader tires. They'll have the tactical advantage of a perfect stalking trip while avoiding the traffic issues facing the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse finds gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and clear runs appear late
scenarios.body: The better handicapped hold-up horses like Femme Beauty or Divine Believer can exploit a slow pace with strong finishing kicks. They'll need luck in running but could benefit from a crawling gallop that plays to their strengths.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If Honouramongthieves goes too fast early and the field bunches up
scenarios.body: A mad scramble develops in the straight with any horse capable of winning in a blanket finish. The race becomes a lottery where form goes out the window and track position decides the outcome.
